parts.text: What is the name of the cells classically seen on gram stain of the lesion?

cohort_answer.text: Muriform cells / Medlar bodies / copper penny cells. || Fonsecaea pedrosoi; Fonsecaea compacta; Cladophialophora carrionii (usually occurs in tropical/subtropical areas, associated with farming/decaying vegetation, transmission by traumatic inoculation; non-painful, pruritic, raised scaly, warty/cauliflower-like appearance occurring weeks-months after trauma). || Itraconazole; Terbinafine; Cryo + liquid nitrogen; Posaconazole.
